diagnosis: Cross-process cache SELECT and job UPSERT were not one transaction. A sibling could archive and complete the signature in between; the stale UPSERT resurrected the completed job.
repair: BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers cache check and queue mutation; atomic claim reconciles queued jobs already satisfied by immutable cache before reserving transport.
regression: Deterministically cache a body after queueing and before claiming; require no claimed job or transport reservation. Existing concurrent test retained; 100 repeated concurrent trials passed.
